title: English Conversation 42:  Missing Order
content: 1. a receipt: a piece of paper or record that has a summary what one bought - If you want to return a product to the store, then you need to have a receipt. - Do you need a receipt? 2. to look something up: to find information in a book or online - I will look the meaning of this word up in the dictionary. - Can you look up the address online? 3. an error: a mistake - My boss was angry because my report had many errors. - I think this is an error. Please check and see if this is correct.
